acip: ZHAL LUNG LAS, ,'DI YI DON LDAN 'GA' ZHIG LA, ,NGA NI DE YI LUS GNAS TE, ,SGRUB PO GZHAN LA MCHOD PA LEN, ,DE YIS DE MNYES RANG GI RGYUD, ,LAS KYI SGRIB PA DAG BYED DO,
wylie: zhal lung las, ,'di yi don ldan 'ga' zhig la, ,nga ni de yi lus gnas te, ,sgrub po gzhan la mchod pa len, ,de yis de mnyes rang gi rgyud, ,las kyi sgrib pa dag byed do
english: The Word of the Glorious Gentle Voice too says, I come and stay within the bodies Of a few who have the meaning, And bring attainments.  I take Where others are offering. This is then what pleases, And works to purify them Of the obstacles of past deeds.
